_comment: Hosts other than this machine that can run a whole engine for a ready-wave. `local` is implicit and never listed. Keys are host names; an entry needs ssh (the ssh alias), home, reposDir (where the host's repo checkouts live), and sdHome (the host's ship-dag checkout), and may give coHome, sessionSlots and leaseSlots (positive integers) and toolchains (any of node, python, xcode). A repo or an issue picks a host with `host`: in references/repo-ci-profiles.json, or on a spec issue (which wins). emit-config --by-host splits a spec into one config per host; scripts/lib/split-by-host.mjs holds the toolchain guard.

mini._note: M1 Mac mini, 8 GB RAM, about 13 GB of disk, Xcode.app selected with its license accepted, iOS simulator runtimes installed. sessionSlots stays 2 for node work, but ship-dag has no per-toolchain session cap, so an Xcode session shares those two slots: run any wave that holds an Xcode repo (wxyc-ios-64, wxyc-dj-ios) on this host with --parallel 1, because two xcodebuild runs do not fit in 8 GB or on the disk.
